summary: Soft landscaping for a new townhouse site, built to the general contractor's drawings.
scope: Tree and shrub planting to plan
story: The general contractor needed landscaping finished in phases as each building block closed out.
We worked to the landscape drawings, coordinated deliveries with the site supervisor and attended a deficiency walkthrough at the end of each phase.
Read more about [landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/), see our work in [Langford](/areas/langford/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: Landscape phases completed to the drawings and handed over with deficiencies closed.
